name: Lydia Jersey Shift Dress, Washed Black
desc: An integral part of TOAST's loungewear range for a decade, the Lydia shift dress has a back slit for ease of movement. Made from washed organic cotton jersey to a simple shape, turning to reveal a half placket and corozo buttons running down from the scooping back. The washed black colourway is garment-dyed.
details: Back half placket with corozo buttons
why: soft cotton jersey, black, back slit for movement
reason: The closet has 37 TOAST pieces and leans on dark, easy dresses. This is their most-worn jersey shape, in black, with a back slit so it moves.

name: Irene Linen Midi Dress, Ivory Bloom Scatter
desc: A standout floral print dress crafted from pure linen with a 100% cotton lining. Breathable, with billowy short sleeves and a stretchy waistline; the romantic tiers and soft gathers only add to its appeal.
why: breathable linen, tiered skirt, stretchy waist, print hides a warm night
reason: Boden is the closet's biggest label. This is a tiered linen midi in a print, the same recipe as the Heidi and Marcia dresses already saved there.

name: Taylor Cardigan in Cotton Cashmere, Ivory
desc: The cardigan you can wear as a top, in supersoft cotton-cashmere. The fit is drapey with a cool roll-edge detail: a boxy, oversized shape with fitted sleeves. Tuck it into your favourite vintage jeans and go.
details: Boxy, oversized shape with fitted sleeves
why: soft cotton-cashmere, boxy cardigan that works as a top or a layer
reason: Cardigans are thin on the ground in the closet. Alex Mill's cotton-cashmere one works as a top on its own or as the layer over a dress on teaching days.

name: Safe Skirt, Trippy Flowers
desc: The Safe Skirt is a shorter take on Howlin's Cosmic Skirt, with a wrap-around waistline and two Japanese snap buttons at the waist. Trippy Flowers is a bold in-house print that brings playful energy and colour to lightweight cotton. Proudly made in Belgium.
details: Wrap-around waist with two snap buttons
why: lightweight cotton wrap skirt, bold print, shorter length
reason: The closet already has a Howlin' sweater from Morrison. This is the same Belgian house's signature cotton print, cut as an easy wrap skirt, currently well under list.

name: Tino Double Pleated Wide Easy Pant, Dune Linen Twill
desc: 18 East's widest leg trouser with zero taper, reintroduced in 100% linen twill. After feedback that last season's ran narrow, the measurements were eased and elastic added to the back of the waistband for a truer, more comfortable fit. The Tino fits easy through the top with deep double reverse pleats and a full cut leg all the way to the hem.
why: breathable linen, full wide leg, eased waist, room to move
reason: Wide linen legs show up all over the closet, from the Somerset pants to the Colette. 18 East's version is the widest of the lot and entirely linen.

name: The Dawn Dress, Squirrel's Bounty
desc: A short-sleeved midi dress with pockets, crafted of 100% regenerative cotton and digitally printed with organic dyes. A snap closure at the neckline and an adjustable drawstring waist let it be worn cinched or loose. Bra friendly and unlined.
why: light cotton midi, drawstring waist, pockets, small print hides sweat
reason: New label. Christy Dawn in Los Angeles makes printed cotton midis with pockets and a drawstring waist, which is the shape the closet keeps returning to.

name: Sally Short-Sleeved Worksuit, Stripe
desc: The Sally Worksuit takes a slouchy approach to the classic worksuit, with front buttons, pockets and a self-tie belt, in soft washed striped cotton twill. Made in New York City.
why: washed cotton twill, slouchy relaxed cut, collared and belted
reason: New label. Loup is a small New York maker cut in sizes XXS to 4X. With seven jumpsuits just added to the closet, a slouchy cotton worksuit is a natural next step.

name: Dolly Dress, Poison Ivy
colorDetail: Poison Ivy print by Ali Mac
desc: A dress named after Dolly Parton. Button up the collar for the nine-to-five and button down for drinks after. Made of 100% stretch cotton jersey that hugs in the right places, with a flattering A-line silhouette, cuffed sleeves and a length that lands just above the knee. Featuring the artwork of Ali Mac.
why: stretch cotton jersey, A-line, dark botanical print, collared
reason: New label. Nooworks in San Francisco prints artists' work on stretch cotton. The Dolly is a collared button dress that goes from classroom to drinks, in a dark print that forgives a dance floor.
